name: literature-search-mcp
description: Standalone stdio MCP server for deterministic multi-source scholarly literature search

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['dist','.test-dist']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/test/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && LITERATURE_SEARCH_LIVE=1 node --test .test-dist/test/live.test.js
scripts.history:clear: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js clear-history
